# @mission-platform/mcp

Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that helps AI assistants use the Mission
Platform monorepo. No runtime dependencies; compiled with `tsc` via Turborepo
and run from its built output on Node.js 24+ (`node mcp/dist/index.js`). Speaks
JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio.

## What it is for

Give an AI assistant grounded, repo-specific help with the seven core workflows:

1. Component usage — discover components and their props, get Vue/React imports.
2. Package creation — scaffold a convention-compliant `packages/<name>`.
3. Package development — layout, public API, build/test/lint, changesets.
4. App creation — scaffold a `apps/<name>` Vite + Vue 3 app.
5. App development — compose packages; deploy via Cloudflare/base-spa.
6. Worker creation — scaffold a `workers/<name>` Cloudflare Worker.
7. Worker development — typed `fetch` handler; keep workers thin.

## Capabilities

- Tools: `get_guide`, `list_docs`, `read_doc`, `search_docs`, `list_components`,
  `get_component_usage`, `list_packages`, `list_apps`, `list_workers`,
  `get_member_info`, `scaffold_package`, `scaffold_app`, `scaffold_worker`.
- Resources: `mission://guide/<id>`, `mission://inventory`, `mission://docs/<slug>`.
- Prompts: `use-component`, `create-package`, `develop-package`, `create-app`,
  `develop-app`, `create-worker`, `develop-worker`.

## Safety

All repo inspection is read-only. Scaffolding tools are dry-run unless
`apply: true`, and never overwrite an existing folder.

## Run

```bash
pnpm exec turbo run build --filter @mission-platform/mcp  # build to dist/
node mcp/dist/index.js                                    # start the stdio server
pnpm --dir mcp test                                       # node --test
```
